scope: Independent source/AST review, actual authorization+immutable-old-ledger validation, and temporary synthetic stdlib fixtures only. Not a launch, live proof, or future-monitor-health receipt.
reviewed_checks: Authorization exact SHA is pinned in source; actual authorization and legacy ledger bytes validated read-only.
Old V8 source exact SHA is pinned, all old closed rows retained as exact full prefix, costs summed including failures; old unused credit not added.
One authorization claim is published exclusively using hard-link creation and fsync, preventing a deleted-ledger reset or duplicate initialization.
New ledger and claim bind exact executing guard source SHA; later source changes block validation.
New launches accept only the newly registered schema and sole new ledger path; old schema dispatch is read-only.
Local new-ledger, global native-work, source-ledger and inherited lineage locks serialize launches and block old-lineage overlap.
Duplicate phase names and existing logs/proofs are rejected; fresh immutable child proof uses O_EXCL.
New proof binds boot, supervisor PID/birth, child PID/birth/UID/session/process group, own source SHA, actual CPU cap/cost/reserve and exact running ledger row.
Live old-boot/old-schema proofs are rejected; old closed proofs delegate to pinned old V8 verifier instead of relabelling.
Actual CPU reads cumulative process-birth ticks with child CPU, high-water accounting, finite cleanup reserve and identity-checked containment; unknown extra process members fail closed.
Workspace free bytes checked before launch and each monitor poll; CPU/cgroup/disk heartbeat persisted at least once per elapsed second subject to OS/I/O scheduling.
Native V8 exit/reap/identity/signal/CPU helpers retain exact AST; execution-loop diff adds observations and fail-closed bookkeeping without altering stop calculations.
Unknown startup CPU or failed post-exit process ownership blocks budget reuse; failed actual costs are charged, no unknown-orphan closure inferred.

Generic closure allows an explicitly requested known failed independent job only with authenticated proof/log/worker/output, finite actual cost and owned-process closure; it does not label science success.
execution_loop_diff_reviewed: boot and legacy-monitor hash in proof
unknown startup CPU fails closed rather than zero cost
material_limits: RSS and sampled actual CPU stops remain best effort under OS scheduling; proof labels that scope.
Static+fixture review does not assert that a future launched process is live or that its monitor remains healthy.
The guard enforces resources and closure; the separate driver must enforce the finite scientific stage schedule and checkpoint/source qualification.
